en.intro: The Cherri Bomb BFF Tee is Hazbin Hotel merchandise: a unisex tee in 100% cotton with art by Calis. FeelBetter buys it from the overseas seller after you order and ships it to you in Korea.
highlights: 100% cotton makes it an easy tee for everyday wear.
It is a unisex tee, so it can be worn by anyone.
Art by Calis gives the tee its Hazbin Hotel look.
Five sizes (M, L, XL, 3XL and 4XL) are offered at the same price.
It is bought from an official or authorised seller, and the concierge checks the model and size before listing.

sections.p: The seller's description opens with the line “He's a troublemaker.” and lists the tee as 100% cotton and unisex, with art by Calis. The listed weight is 227 g.
This tee is listed in M, L, XL, 3XL and 4XL, all at the same price. The seller gives no size measurements, so if you are between sizes or need a size that is not listed, ask the concierge.

cautions: The seller lists this tee as shipping in October, so delivery may take longer than the usual 7–14 business days; ask the concierge if timing matters.
There is no S or 2XL option for this tee, so check the available sizes before ordering.
